questions.question: Irfan bought a chair for Rs. 517 with a discount of 6% on the marked price. Find the marked price of the chair.
questions.solution:
Given:

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 517

Discount = 6%

Formula used:

SP = MP – Discount

Where, SP = Selling Price

CP = Cost Price

Calculation:

Let Marked price (MP) of chair be Rs. x

According to the question:

⇒ Discount = 6% of x = Rs. 0.06x

Now,

SP = MP – Discount

⇒ SP = x – 0.06x

⇒ 517 = 0.94x

⇒ x = 517/0.94 = Rs. 550

∴ Marked Price of chair is Rs. 550.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

**Calculation:**

Marked price = M.P

S.P = (1 - 0.06) M.P

⇒ M.P = S.P/0.94 = 517/0.94 = 550

∴ Marked Price of chair is Rs. 550.

questions.question: How many whole numbers are there between 52 and 356 which are exactly divisible by 6?
questions.solution:
Number between 52 and 356 which is exactly divisible by 6 are 54, 60, 66, 72, 78 …… 354

Nth term of the series will be 6n + k

For n = 1, Nth term = 54

6 × 1 + k = 54

⇒ k = 48

Nth term = 6n + 48

For total number of terms,

6n + 48 = 354

⇒ n = 51

∴ there are 51 numbers between 52 and 356 which is exactly divisible by 6.

questions.question: When a manufacturer allows 10% commission on the wholesale price of Rs. 5000 for a particular item, he earns a profit of 25%. How much profit does the manufacturer earn on that item?
questions.solution:
Marked price = M.P = Rs. 5000

After allowing commission of 10%

Sale price = S.P = (1 - 0.1) × 5000 = 0.9 × 5000 = 4500

Profit % = 25%

Profit percentage = (profit/C.P) × 100 = {(S.P - C.P)/C.P} × 100

C.P = cost price

{(4500 - C.P)/C.P} × 100 = 25

⇒ 450000 - 100C.P = 25C.P

⇒ 125C.P = 450000

⇒ C.P = 3600

∴ Profit earned by manufacturer on that item = S.P - C.P = 4500 - 3600 = 900

questions.question: A bus runs at an average speed of 32 km/hr. If it completes 304 km long journey with a break of 30 minutes, what is the total time taken during the journey?
questions.solution:
Speed = distance/time

Time = distance/speed

Time taken while bus was moving = 304/32 = 9.5 hrs.

Break of 30 min (0.5 hr) is taken between the journeys.

∴ Total time taken = 9.5 + 0.5 = 10 hrs.

A can do a piece of work in 4 days. B and C together can do it in 3 days, while A and C together can do it in 2 days. How many days will B take to do the work alone?
questions.solution:
A’s one day work = 1/4

A and C one day work = 1/2

⇒ C’s one day work = 1/2 - 1/4 = 1/4

B and C one day work = 1/3

⇒ B’s one day work = 1/3 - 1/4 = 1/12

∴ B can complete the work in 12 days

questions.question: The total surface area of a cube is 726 cm². What is the volume of this cube?
questions.solution:
Let the side of the cube be a

Surface area of cube = 6a²

⇒ 6a² = 726

⇒ a² = 121

⇒ a = 11 cm

Volume of cube = a³ = 11³ = 1331 cm³

questions.question: What least number must be added to 748 so that the number is completely divisible by 59?
questions.solution:
When we divide 748 by 59 we get 40 as a remainder

∴ If we add 19 (59 - 40), the new number formed = 748 + 19 = 767

and 767 is completely divisible by 59.

questions.question: What will be the annual simple interest rate if a principal amount of Rs. 88,000 becomes Rs. 1,61,920 in 6 years?
questions.solution:
Principal amount = P = Rs. 88,000

P becomes Rs. 1,61,920 in 6 years

⇒ Simple interest = 1,61,920 - 88,000 = Rs. 73,920

S.I = (P × r × t)/100

S.I = Simple interest

P = Principal

r = Rate

t = time

⇒ Rs. 73,920 = (88000 × r × 6) \100

⇒ r = 14

∴ Rate of interest = 14%

questions.question: Price of a house came down by 10% during recession. After one year, the price increased by 15%. What was the effective percentage change over the original price?
questions.solution:
Let the original price of the house be Rs. X

When price came down by 10%

Price = (1 - 0.1) x = 0.9x

When price is increased by 15%

Price = (1 + 0.15) 0.9x = 1.15 × 0.9x = 1.035x

Percentage change over original price = {(1.035x - x)/x} × 100 = 0.035 × 100 = 3.5%

questions.question: A shopkeeper buys a dozen umbrella for Rs. 1200. Two of the umbrellas were damaged during transportation. Find his profit percentage, if he sells rest of the umbrellas at Rs. 150 each?
questions.solution:
Cost price of each umbrella = 1200/12 = 100

Only 10 good umbrella is left to sell

Selling price of each umbrella = 150

Selling price of the lot = 10 × 150 = 1500

Profit = selling price - cost price = 1500 - 1200 = 300

Profit percentage = (profit/cost price) × 100 = (300/1200) × 100 = 25%

questions.question: Rahul does complete a work in 25 hours. If Rajesh is 25% more efficient than Rahul then how much hours will Rajesh take to complete the same work?
questions.solution:
Rahul complete a work in 25 hours

Rahul’s 1 hour work = 1/25

∵ Rajesh is 25% more efficient than Rahul

⇒ Rajesh’s 1 hour work = (1 + 0.25) × (1/25) = 1/20

∴ Rajesh can complete the work in 20 hours

questions.question: If Rs. 1638 is divided in the ratio of 8 : 7 : 11 among A, B and C respectively, what will be the share of C?
questions.solution:

A total of 26 (8 + 7 + 11) parts will be made, out of which C will get 11 parts

questions.question: The largest 5 - digit number divisible by 21 is ______
questions.solution:
Largest 5 digit number is 99999

Dividing 99999 by 21, we get 18 as remainder

Largest 5 digit number divisible by 21 = 99999 - 18 = 99981

questions.question: How much more amount is spent on Banana than Orange?
questions.solution:
20% of monthly food expense is on fruit

Expense on fruit = 20% of 7500 = 0.2 × 7500 = 1500

26% of which is spent on banana

Amount spent on banana = 26% of 1500 = 0.26 × 1500 = 390

20% spent on orange

Amount spent on orange = 20% of 1500 = 0.20 × 1500 = 300

Difference of amount spend on banana and orange = 390 - 300 = 90

Rs. 90 is spend more on banana than orange

questions.question: What is the ratio of amount spent on Orange and Grapes?
questions.solution:
20% of monthly food expense is on fruit

Expense on fruit = 20% of 7500 = 0.2 × 7500 = 1500

20% spent on orange

Amount spent on orange = 20% of 1500 = 0.20 × 1500 = 300

15% of which is spent on grapes

Amount spent on grapes = 15% of 1500 = 0.15 × 1500 = 225

Ratio of amount spend on orange and grapes = amount spent on orange : amount spent on grapes = 300 : 225 = 4 : 3

questions.question: The amount spent on Pomegranate is how much less than spent on Orange?

Expense on fruit = 20% of 7500 = 0.2 × 7500 = 1500

20% spent on orange

Amount spent on orange = 20% of 1500 = 0.20 × 1500 = 300

Amount spent on Pomegranate = 16% of 1500 = 0.16 × 1500 = 240

Difference in amount spent on orange and Pomegranate = 300 - 240 = 60

Rs. 60 less is spent on Pomegranate than orange
